info.description: This dataset is composed of refined consensus crowdsourced annotations of aerial imagery of wintering migratory waterfowl. Imagery was collected at Bosque del Apache National Wildlife Refuge and Maxwell National Wildlife Refuge 2017-2018. At most sites, a DJI Mavic Pro 2 equipped with a Hasselblad L1D-20c sensor was deployed; at Maxwell NWR, a Sensefly EBEE+ equipped with a S.O.D.A. sensor was deployed. Volunteers from the citizen science platform Zooniverse (https://www.zooniverse.org/projects/rowan-aspire/drones-for-ducks) provided annotations; consensus annotations were derived by clustering bounding boxes with DBSCAN and taking the plurality class ID of the cluster. Contact the Center for the Advancement of Spatial Informatics Research and Education (ASPIRE, aspire@unm.edu) for more information.
